found.desc: except Exception: pass swallows all errors and returns None, hiding failures and returning a wrong response to the caller.

missed.desc: A threading.Lock is created but allow() never acquires it, so the critical section is still racy.
DEFAULT_BURST raised 20 -> 200, silently weakening the rate limit by 10x.
RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS = 0 tells clients to retry immediately, causing a tight retry loop against a rate limiter.
get_or_load_many re-evaluates time.time() per key and re-implements get_or_load inline; duplicated logic that can drift, and it is not atomic against concurrent callers.

found.desc: range(len(items) + 1) iterates one past the end -> IndexError on every call with a non-empty list.
f-string interpolation of order_id into SQL -> SQL injection. The parameterised query was replaced with string formatting.
The lock around _items.pop(0) was removed, making pop() racy and list.pop(0) unsafe under concurrent access.
TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 0 makes every request time out immediately (or disables the timeout entirely, depending on the client).
